'''Pat Brennan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 New Jersey State Championship]] on 8 April 2000 with Tatooine mains (Jabba's Palace start), according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d489">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00d489/ cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00d489/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
